captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic camera lens with a cylindrical black barrel. It features a curved glass element at the top and two distinct textured control rings (focus and zoom) with vertical ridges around the middle section. The entire body has a professional matte black finish, while the lens element has a dark, semi-reflective glass appearance.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic camera lens with a matte black barrel, textured focus and zoom rings, and a dark glass optical element at the top. The lens barrel should be a multi-step cylinder with ribbed control rings, and the glass element should have a smooth, spherical top surface.
captions.factory: The camera lens is constructed using cylindrical primitives. The main barrel is built from a combination of concentric cylinders of varying diameters to form the stepped outer body. The textured control rings are created by subtracting or adding small vertical rectangular patterns (grooves) periodically around the circumference of the rings. The top glass element is modeled using a sphere or a dome shape intersecting with a cylinder, assigned a semi-transparent dark glass material, while the body uses a matte black plastic/metal material.
